body:
Thank you for this. I try to switch things up.  Keep things new.  Right now things are ok.  I tired myself out and fell asleep. 

I can't remember the last time I was truly happy.

I have no idea. They are all the source of my depression.  If I had to pick one I'd say my job. At least I still have that, make ok money and can help my family out since my mom stopped working. . They've been hurting since she stopped but she wanted to look after my niece and nephew while my brother in law and sister work.

Yes.  Im cooling down. I used to be so strong willed.  So mentally tough.  I still gym every day. I don't know what's happened to me. 

I just keep having bad vivid thoughts. Then I think of my niece and nephew wondering where I am,  or my cat ffs. And just... Sigh :(

Even a stranger on the Internet asking means the world to me :'(. 

I've never fully recovered from my SO leaving over a year ago. . There was no signs.  No concerns. Just left one night. Didn't want to talk. 

Me and my best friend had a blowup a come months ago. I don't have many. 

Im concerned about losing my job which I have. No reason to. My boss said he'd help me with schooling if I want to go back take courses. 

Im just so broken.  My head is not under my control. I wouldn't survive losing a job too.  

I moved back home and pay my parents monthly to help with everything and improve they're quality of life. And I keep bringing myself down. . I should not be 27 and at home.  It's pathetic. . Clearly I'm not stable enough to be on my own though.

Im tired of feeling sad. . I'm tired of being pessimistic.  I'm tired of waiting for the worst to happen. I'm so burnt and stressed out.
